shortDescription: Created/Removes/Edits Nodes in Solarwinds Orion NPM

options.name: hostname
options.description: Name of Orion host running SWIS service. If not defined in the task, the value of E(SOLARWINDS_SERVER) will be used instead.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: IP Address of the node. One of I(ip_address), I(node_id), or I(name) is required.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the node. When I(state=present), this field is required. When state is other than present, one of I(ip_address), I(node_id), or I(name) is required.

options.name: node_id
options.description: Node ID of the node. One of I(ip_address), I(node_id), or I(name) is required.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Orion user. If not defined in the task, the value of E(SOLARWINDS_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: polling_engine
options.description: ID of polling engine that NPM will use to poll this device. If not passed, will query for the Polling Engine with least nodes assigned. Not recommended to use I(polling_engine=1), which should be the main app server.

options.name: polling_method
options.description: Polling method to use.

options.name: port
options.description: Port to connect to the Solarwinds Information Service API. Solarwinds ver. 2024.1.0 and on has a new API on port 17774, with legacy supported on 17778. This argument was introduced in orionsdk 0.4.0 to support connecting to either API. If using an older version of Solarwinds with orionsdk 0.4.0, define this as port 17778.

options.name: ro_community_string
options.description: SNMP Read-Only Community string. Required if I(polling_method=snmp).

options.name: rw_community_string
options.description: SNMP Read-Write Community string.

options.name: snmp_allow_64
options.description: Set true if device supports 64-bit counters.

options.name: snmp_port
options.description: Port that SNMP server listens on.

options.name: snmp_version
options.description: SNMPv2c or SNMPv3 for snmp polling.

options.name: snmpv3_auth_key
options.description: Authentication passphrase for SNMPv3. Required when SNMP version is 3.

options.name: snmpv3_auth_key_is_pwd
options.description: SNMPv3 Authentication Password is a key. Confusingly, value of True corresponds to web GUI checkbox being unchecked.

options.name: snmpv3_auth_method
options.description: Authentication method for SNMPv3. Required when SNMP version is 3.

options.name: snmpv3_credential_set
options.description: Credential set name for SNMPv3 credentials. Optional when SNMP version is 3.

options.name: snmpv3_priv_key
options.description: Privacy passphrase for SNMPv3.

options.name: snmpv3_priv_key_is_pwd
options.description: SNMPv3 Privacy Password is a key. Confusingly, value of True corresponds to web GUI checkbox being unchecked.

options.name: snmpv3_priv_method
options.description: Privacy method for SNMPv3.

options.name: snmpv3_username
options.description: Read-Only SNMPv3 username. Required when SNMP version is 3.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the node.

options.name: unmanage_from
options.description: The date and time (in ISO 8601 UTC format) to begin the unmanage period. If this is in the past, the node will be unmanaged effective immediately. If not provided, module defaults to now. ex: 2017-02-21T12:00:00Z

options.name: unmanage_until
options.description: The date and time (in ISO 8601 UTC format) to end the unmanage period. You can set this as far in the future as you like. If not provided, module defaults to 24 hours from now. ex: 2017-02-21T12:00:00Z

options.name: username
options.description: Orion Username. Active Directory users must use DOMAIN\\username format. If not defined in the task, the value of E(SOLARWINDS_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: verify
options.description: Verify SSL Certificate for Solarwinds Information Service API. Requires orionsdk >= 0.4.0

options.name: wmi_credential_set
options.description: Credential Name already configured in NPM  Found under "Manage Windows Credentials" section of the Orion website (Settings). Note: creation of credentials are not supported at this time. Required if I(polling_method=wmi).
